k-nvda.title: Jensen Huang NVDA return and red-bra meme coins
k-nvda.sourceSays: Posts say Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and that Trump posted a meme of Huang holding a red bra; a new Pump.fun NBI coin is built on a red-bra Shiba.
k-nvda.reason: Posts of Nov 23 report Huang's reinstatement and a Trump red-bra meme at 16:43 UTC; NBI (1.0h old) is bra-themed and opened after it. The other NVDA coins are a 3x token and a Venus meme.

k-sym-SEXCOIN.reason: Saved posts are call-group shills with CA and multiples; a SEXCOIN ticker already circulated Nov 6 and the new pool predates the Trump posts, so no story behind it.
